# Desert Valley Contracting Inc 

Doing business as: Desert Valley Restoration-24/7 Emergency Plumbing, Water and Fire Damage Restoration (registered trade name of Desert Valley Contracting Inc).

> 24/7 restoration services in North Las Vegas, NV.

Desert Valley Contracting Inc  (Desert Valley Contracting Inc ) is a professional restoration contractor serving North Las Vegas, NV and surrounding areas since 2000. We provide 24/7 emergency response for water, fire, mold, storm, biohazard, and reconstruction services. Phone: (702) 633-5033 · Email: relliston@desertvalleyco.com.
